video.title: What is Microsoft Foundry & how it works? #ai Sponsored by Microsoft

transcript.text: Most developers can build an AI app in a
weekend, but the hard part is turning it
into something a company can actually
use. And that's where Microsoft Foundry
comes in. Right inside VS Code, Foundry
gives developers access to thousands of
models including Claude, GPT, and Llama
in a single platform. And the best part
is you're not logged into one model. You
can switch models without rebuilding
your application. But building an app is
half the challenge. Real companies use
AI that work with their data and tools.
With Foundry IQ, you can create search
indexes and also connect your company
knowledge so your AI can answer using
trusted information. Foundry also
supports more than 1400 MCP servers, so
you can connect your AI applications
with GitHub, Slack, etc. And when it's
time to scale, Model Router can
automatically direct simple requests to
lower cost model and complex requests to
advanced model saving you cost. So now
you have freedom to choose your favorite
models along with the tools needed to
deploy, manage, and scale AI in
production. Check out Microsoft Foundry
and start building directly in VS Code.
Subscribe.
